title: Household Plan Purchase Credit — Alignment Services & Plans
content:
Alignment Services & Plans gives a purchase credit on a new household plan according to the price at which the household plan the customer already holds was itself bought:

| Household plan was bought at | Credit taken off the household price |
|---|---|
| its line's full plan price | 15.00 |
| its line's plan price less exactly its line's tire bundle discount | 5.00 |
| any other price | 0.00 |

For the two lifetime lines the figures are:

| Household plan's line | Full plan price | Plan price less exactly the tire bundle discount |
|---|---|---|
| Crestline Lifetime Alignment Plan | 249.99 | 249.99 less 40.00: 209.99 |
| Crestline Lifetime Alignment Plan Truck & Performance | 299.99 | 299.99 less 40.00: 259.99 |

The credit is worked out on its own and taken off the household price, which is rounded to the nearest cent and never falls below 0.00.

*Hypothetical:* a household plan on the Crestline Lifetime Alignment Plan bought for 229.99 matches neither figure, so the credit is 0.00.
